The original FFT is also assuming unit cost multiplication when we say it is O(n log n) time - we mean O(n log n) multiplies.

Words are embedded in (yes, evolving) traditions of use. They are situated in systems of other words and ideas. A precise definition (and often a history of the word and the turna its meaning has taken over time) serves to train you, just a little, in that entire tradition— in its motivations, its other ideas, and adjacent terms.
